sanskrit_iast: kātyāyanaśulbasūtra rajjusamāsaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ
meaning: कात्यायनशुल्बसूत्र रज्जुसमासं वक्ष्यामः
text_mt: [Now] we shall state the collection of cord [rules] of the Kātyāyanaśulbasūtra.

sanskrit_iast: same śaṅkue nikhāya śaṅkusammitayā rajjvā maṇḍalaṃ parilikhya yatra lekhayoḥ śaṅkvagracchāyā nipatati tatra śaṅkū nihanti sā prācī | tadantaraṃ rajjvābhyasya pāśau kṛtvā śaṅkvoḥ pāśau pratimucya dakṣiṇāyamya madhye śaṅkumevamuttarataḥ sodīcī
meaning: समे शङ्कुए निखाय शङ्कुसम्मितया रज्ज्वा मण्डलं परिलिख्य यत्र लेखयोः शङ्क्वग्रच्छाया निपतति तत्र शङ्कू निहन्ति सा प्राची । तदन्तरं रज्ज्वाभ्यस्य पाशौ कृत्वा शङ्क्वोः पाशौ प्रतिमुच्य दक्षिणायम्य मध्ये शङ्कुमेवमुत्तरतः सोदीची

sanskrit_iast: rajjvantayoḥ pāśau karoti | śroṇyaṃsanirañchanasaṃkhyāsamāsabhaṅgeṣu lakṣaṇāni | prācyantayoḥ śaṅku nihanti | śroṇyoraṃsayośca | śaṅkvoḥ pāśau pratimucya nirañchanena gṛhītvā dakṣiṇapūrvāṃ diśaṃ haranti | evamuttarataḥ | viparyasyetarataḥ | sa samādhiḥ sarvatra
meaning: रज्ज्वन्तयोः पाशौ करोति । श्रोण्यंसनिरञ्छनसंख्यासमासभङ्गेषु लक्षणानि । प्राच्यन्तयोः शङ्कु निहन्ति । श्रोण्योरंसयोश्च । शङ्क्वोः पाशौ प्रतिमुच्य निरञ्छनेन गृहीत्वा दक्षिणपूर्वां दिशं हरन्ति । एवमुत्तरतः । विपर्यस्येतरतः । स समाधिः सर्वत्र
text_mt: One makes loops at the two ends of the cord. [One makes] marks at the buttocks, the shoulders, the intermediate marker, the number, the combination, and the breaks. One drives in a peg at each end of the east-west line, and at the two buttocks and the two shoulders. Having slipped the loops onto the two pegs and grasped [the cord] by the intermediate marker, they stretch it toward the south-east quarter. Likewise toward the north. In reverse toward the other [side]. That is the procedure everywhere.

sanskrit_iast: pramāṇamabhyasyābhyāsacaturthe lakṣṇaṃ karoti tannirañchanam | akṣṇayā tiryaṅmānīśeṣa
meaning: प्रमाणमभ्यस्याभ्यासचतुर्थे लक्ष्णं करोति तन्निरञ्छनम् । अक्ष्णया तिर्यङ्मानीशेष
text_mt: Having doubled the measure, one makes a mark at one-fourth of the doubled [cord]; that is the intermediate marker. The diagonal cord is the remainder of the transverse measure.

sanskrit_iast: pramāṇārdhaṃ vābhyasyābhyāsaṣaṣṭhe lakṣaṇaṃ karoti tannirañchanam | akṣṇayā tiryaṅmāniśeṣaḥ
meaning: प्रमाणार्धं वाभ्यस्याभ्यासषष्ठे लक्षणं करोति तन्निरञ्छनम् । अक्ष्णया तिर्यङ्मानिशेषः
text_mt: Or having doubled half the measure, one makes a mark at one-sixth of the doubled [cord]; that is the intermediate marker. The diagonal cord is the remainder of the transverse measure.

sanskrit_iast: pramāṇārdhe samacaturaśrasya śaṅkuḥ | śāstravadardhe dīrghacaturaśrasya | śakaṭamukhasya caivam
meaning: प्रमाणार्धे समचतुरश्रस्य शङ्कुः । शास्त्रवदर्धे दीर्घचतुरश्रस्य । शकटमुखस्य चैवम्
text_mt: At half the measure is the peg for a square. At the half according to the precept is [the peg] for a rectangle. And likewise for the chariot-front.

sanskrit_iast: etena prāgvaṃśavedimānāni vyākhyātāni | śālāmānaṃ ca | tatrodīcī prācīvat | sadasaścaivam
meaning: एतेन प्राग्वंशवेदिमानानि व्याख्यातानि । शालामानं च । तत्रोदीची प्राचीवत् । सदसश्चैवम्
text_mt: By this the measures of the prāgvaṃśa and the altar ground are explained, as well as the measure of the hall. There the north-south line is like the east-west line. And likewise for the sadas.

sanskrit_iast: aparimitaṃ pramāṇādbhūyaḥ
meaning: अपरिमितं प्रमाणाद्भूयः
text_mt: Unmeasured is greater than the measure.

sanskrit_iast: pramāṇe śāstraṃ pramāṇaṃ nirhāsavivṛddhyoḥ | yogaśca
meaning: प्रमाणे शास्त्रं प्रमाणं निर्हासविवृद्ध्योः । योगश्च
text_mt: In the measure, the precept is the authority for reduction and augmentation, and for addition.

sanskrit_iast: itarasyavitṛtīye dakṣiṇata ityetadvakṣyāmaḥ | gārhapatyāhavanīyayorantarālaṃ ṣaḍhdhā saptadhā vāgantusamaṃ tredhā vibhajyāparavitṛtīyalakṣaṇena dakṣiṇāyamya tasminnagniḥ | viparyasyottarata utkaraḥ
meaning: इतरस्यवितृतीये दक्षिणत इत्येतद्वक्ष्यामः । गार्हपत्याहवनीययोरन्तरालं षढ्धा सप्तधा वागन्तुसमं त्रेधा विभज्यापरवितृतीयलक्षणेन दक्षिणायम्य तस्मिन्नग्निः । विपर्यस्योत्तरत उत्करः
text_mt: We shall explain this: 'In one-third of the other towards the south.' Having divided the interval between the Gārhapatya and Āhavanīya into six or seven parts, or having divided an added equal [length] into three parts and stretched [the cord] southwards with the mark of the western third, the fire altar is upon that. In reverse to the north is the rubbish heap.

sanskrit_iast: apivāntaratribhāgo'nayā rajjvā purvārdhe samacaturaśraṃ kṛtvā śroṇyāmagniḥ | viparyasyottarāṃsa utkaraḥ
meaning: अपिवान्तरत्रिभागोऽनया रज्ज्वा पुर्वार्धे समचतुरश्रं कृत्वा श्रोण्यामग्निः । विपर्यस्योत्तरांस उत्करः
text_mt: Or having made a square with the one-third interval of this cord in the eastern half, the fire altar is at the buttock. In reverse, the rubbish heap is at the northern shoulder.

sanskrit_iast: aṅgulai rathasaṃmitāyāḥ pramāṇam | tatrāṣṭāśītiśatamīṣā | catuḥśatamakṣaḥ | ṣaḍaśītiryugam | catvāro'ṣṭakāḥ śamyā
meaning: अङ्गुलै रथसंमितायाः प्रमाणम् । तत्राष्टाशीतिशतमीषा । चतुःशतमक्षः । षडशीतिर्युगम् । चत्वारोऽष्टकाः शम्या
text_mt: The measure of that which is measured by a chariot is in aṅgulas. There, the pole is one hundred and eighty-eight [aṅgulas]. The axle is one hundred and four. The yoke is eighty-six. The yoke-pins are four sets of eight.

sanskrit_iast: paitṛkyāṃ dvipuruṣaṃ samacaturaśraṃ kṛtvā karaṇīmadhye śaṅkavaḥ sa samādhiḥ
meaning: पैतृक्यां द्विपुरुषं समचतुरश्रं कृत्वा करणीमध्ये शङ्कवः स समाधिः
text_mt: In the ancestral [altar], having made a square of two puruṣas, pegs are [placed] in the middle of the producing sides; that is the procedure.

sanskrit_iast: karaṇī tatkaraṇī tiryaṅmānī pārśvamānyakṣṇayā ceti rajjavaḥ
meaning: करणी तत्करणी तिर्यङ्मानी पार्श्वमान्यक्ष्णया चेति रज्जवः
text_mt: The producing side, its producing side, the transverse measure, the flank measure, and the diagonal cord: these are the cords.

sanskrit_iast: padaṃ tiryaṅmānī tripadā pārśvamānī tasyākṣṇyā rajjurdaśakaraṇī
meaning: पदं तिर्यङ्मानी त्रिपदा पार्श्वमानी तस्याक्ष्ण्या रज्जुर्दशकरणी
text_mt: A pada is the transverse measure; three padas are the flank measure; its diagonal cord is the cord producing ten times the area.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ dvipadā tiryaṅmānī ṣaṭpadā pārśvamānī tasyākṣṇayā rajjuścatvāriṃśatkaraṇī
meaning: एवं द्विपदा तिर्यङ्मानी षट्पदा पार्श्वमानी तस्याक्ष्णया रज्जुश्चत्वारिंशत्करणी
text_mt: Likewise, two padas are the transverse measure; six padas are the flank measure; its diagonal cord is the cord producing forty times the area.

sanskrit_iast: upadiṣṭaṃ yugapramāṇaṃ śamyāpramāṇaṃ ca darśanāt
meaning: उपदिष्टं युगप्रमाणं शम्याप्रमाणं च दर्शनात्
text_mt: The measure of the yoke and the measure of the yoke-pin are taught from observation.

sanskrit_iast: dīrghacaturaśrasyākṣṇayā rajjustiryaṅmānī pārśvamānī ca yatpṛthagbhūte kurutastadubhayaṃ karotīti kṣetrajñānam
meaning: दीर्घचतुरश्रस्याक्ष्णया रज्जुस्तिर्यङ्मानी पार्श्वमानी च यत्पृथग्भूते कुरुतस्तदुभयं करोतीति क्षेत्रज्ञानम्
text_mt: The diagonal cord of a rectangle produces both [areas] which the transverse measure and the flank measure produce separately: this is the knowledge of areas.

sanskrit_iast: samacaturaśrasyākṣṇayā rajjurdvikaraṇī
meaning: समचतुरश्रस्याक्ष्णया रज्जुर्द्विकरणी
text_mt: The diagonal cord of a square is the cord producing twice the area.

sanskrit_iast: karaṇīṃ tṛtīyena vardhayettacca svacaturthenātmacatustṛṃśonena saviśeṣa iti viśeṣaḥ
meaning: करणीं तृतीयेन वर्धयेत्तच्च स्वचतुर्थेनात्मचतुस्तृंशोनेन सविशेष इति विशेषः
text_mt: One should increase the producing side by a third, and that by its own fourth diminished by its thirty-fourth part; this excess is 'with the excess'.

sanskrit_iast: pramāṇaṃ tiryak dvikaraṇyāyāmastasyākṣṇayā rajjustrikaraṇī
meaning: प्रमाणं तिर्यक् द्विकरण्यायामस्तस्याक्ष्णया रज्जुस्त्रिकरणी
text_mt: The measure is the transverse side, the cord producing twice the area is the length; its diagonal cord is the cord producing thrice the area.

sanskrit_iast: tṛtīyakaraṇyetena vyākhyātā | pramāṇavibhāgastu navadhā karaṇītṛtīyaṃ navabhāgaḥ | navabhāgāstrayastṛtīyakaraṇī
meaning: तृतीयकरण्येतेन व्याख्याता । प्रमाणविभागस्तु नवधा करणीतृतीयं नवभागः । नवभागास्त्रयस्तृतीयकरणी
text_mt: The cord producing one-third the area is explained by this. But the division of the measure is into nine parts: one-third of the producing side is a ninth part; three ninth parts are the cord producing one-third the area.

sanskrit_iast: sautrāmaṇyāṃ prakramārthā | tṛtīyakaraṇī samāsārthā
meaning: सौत्रामण्यां प्रक्रमार्था । तृतीयकरणी समासार्था
text_mt: In the Sautrāmaṇī, it serves for the prakrama. The cord producing one-third the area serves for combination.

sanskrit_iast: tulyapramāṇānāṃ samacaturasrāṇāmuktaḥ samāsaḥ | nānāpramāṇasamāse hrasīyasaḥ karaṇyā varṣīyaso'pacchindyāttasyākṣṇayā rajjurubhe samasyatīti samāsaḥ
meaning: तुल्यप्रमाणानां समचतुरस्राणामुक्तः समासः । नानाप्रमाणसमासे ह्रसीयसः करण्या वर्षीयसोऽपच्छिन्द्यात्तस्याक्ष्णया रज्जुरुभे समस्यतीति समासः
text_mt: The combination of squares of equal measure has been stated. In the combination of [squares of] different measures, one should cut off [a portion] of the larger by the producing side of the smaller; its diagonal cord combines both: this is the combination.

sanskrit_iast: caturaśrāccaturaśraṃ nirjihīrṣanyāvannirjihīrṣettāvadubhayato'pacchidya śaṅkū nikhāya pārśvamānīṃ kṛtvā pārśvamānīsammitāmakṣṇayāṃ tatropasaṃharati sa samāse'pacchedaḥ sā karaṇyeṣa nirhrāsaḥ
meaning: चतुरश्राच्चतुरश्रं निर्जिहीर्षन्यावन्निर्जिहीर्षेत्तावदुभयतोऽपच्छिद्य शङ्कू निखाय पार्श्वमानीं कृत्वा पार्श्वमानीसम्मितामक्ष्णयां तत्रोपसंहरति स समासेऽपच्छेदः सा करण्येष निर्ह्रासः
text_mt: Wishing to deduct a square from a square, as much as one wishes to deduct, having cut off that much from both sides, driven in two pegs, and made a flank measure, one brings down the diagonal cord equal to the flank measure upon it; that is the cut in the combination; that is the producing side; this is reduction.

sanskrit_iast: dīrghacaturaśraṃ samacaturaśraṃ cikīrṣan madhye tiryagapacchidyānyataradvibhajyetaratpurastāddakṣiṇataścopadadhyāccheṣamāgantunā purayettasyokto nirhrāsaḥ
meaning: दीर्घचतुरश्रं समचतुरश्रं चिकीर्षन् मध्ये तिर्यगपच्छिद्यान्यतरद्विभज्येतरत्पुरस्ताद्दक्षिणतश्चोपदध्याच्छेषमागन्तुना पुरयेत्तस्योक्तो निर्ह्रासः
text_mt: Wishing to make a rectangle into a square, having cut it across in the middle, one should divide one of the two [halves], place the other at the east and south, and fill the remainder with an added piece; its reduction has been stated.

sanskrit_iast: atidīrghaṃ cettiryaṅmānyāpacchidyāpacchidyaikasamāsena samasya śeṣaṃ yathāyogamupasaṃharedityekaḥ samāsaḥ
meaning: अतिदीर्घं चेत्तिर्यङ्मान्यापच्छिद्यापच्छिद्यैकसमासेन समस्य शेषं यथायोगमुपसंहरेदित्येकः समासः
text_mt: If it is very long, having cut it repeatedly by the transverse measure, and having combined [them] by a single combination, one should bring down the remainder as appropriate: this is one combination.

sanskrit_iast: samacaturaśraṃ dīrghacaturaśraṃ cikīrṣanmadhye'kṣṇayā'pacchidya tacca vibhajyānyataratpurastāduttarataścopadadhyādviṣamaṃ cedyathāyogamupasaṃharediti vyāsaḥ
meaning: समचतुरश्रं दीर्घचतुरश्रं चिकीर्षन्मध्येऽक्ष्णयाऽपच्छिद्य तच्च विभज्यान्यतरत्पुरस्तादुत्तरतश्चोपदध्याद्विषमं चेद्यथायोगमुपसंहरेदिति व्यासः
text_mt: Wishing to make a square into a rectangle, having cut it diagonally in the middle and divided that, one should place one of the two at the east and north; and if it is irregular, one should bring down as appropriate: this is expansion.

sanskrit_iast: pramāṇaṃ caturaśramādeśādanyat
meaning: प्रमाणं चतुरश्रमादेशादन्यत्
text_mt: The measure is a quadrilateral, unless otherwise specified.

sanskrit_iast: dvipramāṇā catuḥkaraṇī tripramāṇa navakaraṇī catuḥpramāṇā ṣoḍaśakaraṇī
meaning: द्विप्रमाणा चतुःकरणी त्रिप्रमाण नवकरणी चतुःप्रमाणा षोडशकरणी
text_mt: [A cord] of two measures is a cord producing four times the area; of three measures, a cord producing nine times the area; of four measures, a cord producing sixteen times the area.

sanskrit_iast: yāvatpramāṇā rajjurbhavati tāvantastāvanto vargā bhavanti tānsamasyet
meaning: यावत्प्रमाणा रज्जुर्भवति तावन्तस्तावन्तो वर्गा भवन्ति तान्समस्येत्
text_mt: As many measures as the cord has, so many squares there are; one should combine them.

sanskrit_iast: ardhapramāṇena pādapramāṇaṃ vidhīyate | tṛtīyena navamoṃ'śaḥ | caturthena ṣoḍaśī kalā
meaning: अर्धप्रमाणेन पादप्रमाणं विधीयते । तृतीयेन नवमोंऽशः । चतुर्थेन षोडशी कला
text_mt: By half a measure, a quarter measure is produced; by a third, a ninth part; by a fourth, a sixteenth fraction.

sanskrit_iast: eṣa nirhrāsastasya purastāduktaṃ śāstram
meaning: एष निर्ह्रासस्तस्य पुरस्तादुक्तं शास्त्रम्
text_mt: This is reduction; the precept for it has been stated before.

sanskrit_iast: yāvatpramāṇā rajjurbhavatīti vivṛddhe hrāso bhavati
meaning: यावत्प्रमाणा रज्जुर्भवतीति विवृद्धे ह्रासो भवति
text_mt: When it is said 'as many measures as the cord has', there is a decrease in augmentation.

sanskrit_iast: caturaśraṃ maṇḍalaṃ cikīrṣanmadhyādaṃse nipātya pārśvataḥ parilikhya tatra yadatiriktaṃ bhavati tasya tṛtīyena saha maṇḍalaṃ parilikhet sa samādhiḥ
meaning: चतुरश्रं मण्डलं चिकीर्षन्मध्यादंसे निपात्य पार्श्वतः परिलिख्य तत्र यदतिरिक्तं भवति तस्य तृतीयेन सह मण्डलं परिलिखेत् स समाधिः
text_mt: Wishing to make a quadrilateral into a circle, having stretched [a cord] from the centre to a shoulder and drawn a line on the side, one should draw a circle with the third part of whatever is surplus there; that is the procedure.

sanskrit_iast: maṇḍalaṃ caturaśraṃ cikīrṣan viṣkambhaṃ pañcadaśabhāgān kṛtvā dvāvuddhareccheṣaḥ karaṇī
meaning: मण्डलं चतुरश्रं चिकीर्षन् विष्कम्भं पञ्चदशभागान् कृत्वा द्वावुद्धरेच्छेषः करणी
text_mt: Wishing to make a circle into a quadrilateral, having divided the diameter into fifteen parts, one should remove two; the remainder is the producing side.

sanskrit_iast: droṇacidrathacakracitkaṅkacitpraugacidubhayataḥ praugaḥ samuhyapurīṣa ityagnayaḥ
meaning: द्रोणचिद्रथचक्रचित्कङ्कचित्प्रौगचिदुभयतः प्रौगः समुह्यपुरीष इत्यग्नयः
text_mt: The trough-shaped altar, chariot-wheel-shaped altar, heron-shaped altar, triangle-shaped altar, rhombus-shaped altar, and heaped-soil altar: these are the fire altars.

sanskrit_iast: droṇe yāvānagniḥ sapakṣapucchaviśeṣastāvaccaturaśraṃ kṛtvā droṇadaśamavibhāgo vṛntamityeke | taddaśamenāpacchidyāpacchidyaikasamāsena samasya nirhṛtya sarvamagniṃ tathākṛtiṃ kṛtvā purastātpaścādvopadadhyāt maṇḍale'pyevam
meaning: द्रोणे यावानग्निः सपक्षपुच्छविशेषस्तावच्चतुरश्रं कृत्वा द्रोणदशमविभागो वृन्तमित्येके । तद्दशमेनापच्छिद्यापच्छिद्यैकसमासेन समस्य निर्हृत्य सर्वमग्निं तथाकृतिं कृत्वा पुरस्तात्पश्चाद्वोपदध्यात् मण्डलेऽप्येवम्
text_mt: In the trough[-shaped altar], having made a quadrilateral as large as the fire altar with the addition of the wings and tail—some say the stalk is a tenth part of the trough—having repeatedly cut off by that tenth, combined them by a single combination, and removed them, having made the entire fire altar of such shape, one should place [the stalk] in front or behind; so also in the circle.

sanskrit_iast: prauge yāvānagniḥ sapakṣapucchaviśeṣastāvaddviguṇaṃ caturaśraṃ kṛtvā yaḥ purastātkaraṇīmadhye śaṅkuryau ca śroṇyoḥ so'gniḥ
meaning: प्रौगे यावानग्निः सपक्षपुच्छविशेषस्तावद्द्विगुणं चतुरश्रं कृत्वा यः पुरस्तात्करणीमध्ये शङ्कुर्यौ च श्रोण्योः सोऽग्निः
text_mt: In the triangle[-shaped altar], having made a quadrilateral twice as large as the fire altar with the addition of the wings and tail, that which is [bounded by] the peg in the middle of the producing side in front and the two at the buttocks, that is the fire altar.

sanskrit_iast: ubhayataḥ prauge tāvadeva dīrghacaturaśraṃ kṛtvā karaṇīmadhyeṣu śaṅkavaḥ sa samādhiḥ
meaning: उभयतः प्रौगे तावदेव दीर्घचतुरश्रं कृत्वा करणीमध्येषु शङ्कवः स समाधिः
text_mt: In the rhombus[-shaped altar], having made a rectangle just as large, pegs are [placed] in the middles of the producing sides; that is the procedure.

sanskrit_iast: praugaṃ caturaśraṃ cikīrṣanmadhye prāñcamapacchidya viparyasyetarata upadhāya dīrghacaturaśrasamāsena samasyet sa samādhiḥ
meaning: प्रौगं चतुरश्रं चिकीर्षन्मध्ये प्राञ्चमपच्छिद्य विपर्यस्येतरत उपधाय दीर्घचतुरश्रसमासेन समस्येत् स समाधिः
text_mt: Wishing to make a triangle into a quadrilateral, having cut it eastwards in the middle, reversed it, placed it on the other side, one should combine it with the combination of a rectangle; that is the procedure.

sanskrit_iast: ubhayataḥ praugaṃ cenmadhye tiryagapacchidya pūrvavatsamasyet
meaning: उभयतः प्रौगं चेन्मध्ये तिर्यगपच्छिद्य पूर्ववत्समस्येत्
text_mt: If it is a rhombus, having cut it transversely in the middle, one should combine it as before.

sanskrit_iast: etenaiva trikarṇasamāso vyākhyātaḥ | pañcakarṇānāṃ ca | prauge'pacchidyaikakarṇānāṃ | dvikarṇānāṃ samacaturaśre'pacchidya
meaning: एतेनैव त्रिकर्णसमासो व्याख्यातः । पञ्चकर्णानां च । प्रौगेऽपच्छिद्यैककर्णानां । द्विकर्णानां समचतुरश्रेऽपच्छिद्य
text_mt: By this very rule the combination of three-cornered figures is explained, and of five-cornered figures; of one-cornered figures by cutting off in a triangle, of two-cornered figures by cutting off in a square.

sanskrit_iast: uttareṣu puruṣoccayenaikaśatavidhādityetadvakṣyāmaḥ
meaning: उत्तरेषु पुरुषोच्चयेनैकशतविधादित्येतद्वक्ष्यामः
text_mt: We shall explain this: 'In the subsequent ones, by an increase of a puruṣa, up to the one-hundred-and-one-fold.'

sanskrit_iast: ādyo'gnirdviguṇastriguṇo bhavatīti sarvasamāsaḥ
meaning: आद्योऽग्निर्द्विगुणस्त्रिगुणो भवतीति सर्वसमासः
text_mt: The first fire altar becomes twofold, threefold: this is the whole combination.

sanskrit_iast: ekaviṃśatividho bhavatīti puruṣābhyāsaḥ
meaning: एकविंशतिविधो भवतीति पुरुषाभ्यासः
text_mt: 'It becomes twenty-one-fold': this is the multiplication of puruṣas.

sanskrit_iast: puruṣābhyāse yāvānagniḥ sapakṣapucchaviśeṣastāvaccaturaśraṃ kṛtvā tasminpuruṣapramāṇamavadadhyāt
meaning: पुरुषाभ्यासे यावानग्निः सपक्षपुच्छविशेषस्तावच्चतुरश्रं कृत्वा तस्मिन्पुरुषप्रमाणमवदध्यात्
text_mt: In the multiplication of puruṣas, having made a square equal to as much as the fire altar is, with its wings, tail, and excess, one should fit into it the measure of a puruṣa.

sanskrit_iast: samastaṃ pañcadaśabhāgānkṛtvā dvāvekasamāsena samasyet sa puruṣaḥ
meaning: समस्तं पञ्चदशभागान्कृत्वा द्वावेकसमासेन समस्येत् स पुरुषः
text_mt: Having divided the whole into fifteen parts, one should combine two by a single combination; that is the puruṣa.

sanskrit_iast: pañcavibhāgena bṛhatī tasya daśamavibhāgena pādamātrī bhavati
meaning: पञ्चविभागेन बृहती तस्य दशमविभागेन पादमात्री भवति
text_mt: The bṛhatī [brick] is [formed] by the fifth division; by its tenth division is the pādamātrī [brick].

sanskrit_iast: puruṣaṃ vā pañcamenobhayato'pacchidya pañcavibhāgansamasya tṛtīyaṃ nirhṛtya tasminpuruṣapramāṇe'vadadhyādityaparam
meaning: पुरुषं वा पञ्चमेनोभयतोऽपच्छिद्य पञ्चविभागन्समस्य तृतीयं निर्हृत्य तस्मिन्पुरुषप्रमाणेऽवदध्यादित्यपरम्
text_mt: Or, cutting off the puruṣa on both sides by a fifth, combining the fifth divisions, and removing a third, one should fit it into that measure of a puruṣa: so says another [authority].

sanskrit_iast: pañcadaśavibhāgo'ṣṭāṅgulam
meaning: पञ्चदशविभागोऽष्टाङ्गुलम्
text_mt: The fifteenth division is eight aṅgulas.

sanskrit_iast: pañcāratnirdaśavitastirviṃśatiśatāṅgulaḥ puruṣa ityetasmāddvādaśāṅgulaṃ padamiti ca
meaning: पञ्चारत्निर्दशवितस्तिर्विंशतिशताङ्गुलः पुरुष इत्येतस्माद्द्वादशाङ्गुलं पदमिति च
text_mt: From the rule that a puruṣa is five aratnis, ten vitastis, [or] one hundred and twenty aṅgulas, [it follows] also that a pada is twelve aṅgulas.

sanskrit_iast: puruṣaṃ vā saptamenobhayato'pacchidya saptabhāgānsamasya sasaptamabhāgamaṅgulaṃ nirhṛtya puruṣapramāṇe'vadadhyādityaparam
meaning: पुरुषं वा सप्तमेनोभयतोऽपच्छिद्य सप्तभागान्समस्य ससप्तमभागमङ्गुलं निर्हृत्य पुरुषप्रमाणेऽवदध्यादित्यपरम्
text_mt: Or, cutting off the puruṣa on both sides by a seventh, combining the seventh parts, and removing an aṅgula with a seventh part, one should fit it into the measure of a puruṣa: so says another [authority].

sanskrit_iast: nāratnivitastīnāṃ samāso vidyate saṃkhyāyogāditi śruteḥ
meaning: नारत्निवितस्तीनां समासो विद्यते संख्यायोगादिति श्रुतेः
text_mt: There is no combination of aratnis and vitastis, because of the application of number, according to the Vedic text.

sanskrit_iast: yathāgni vedīṣṭakāpramāṇaṃ varddhata ityetadvakṣyāmaḥ
meaning: यथाग्नि वेदीष्टकाप्रमाणं वर्द्धत इत्येतद्वक्ष्यामः
text_mt: We shall explain how the measure of the altar ground and the bricks increases according to the fire altar.

sanskrit_iast: yākaraṇī caturdaśaprakramānsaṅkṣipati triṃśca prakramasaptamabhāgān sa ekaśatavidhe prakramaḥ
meaning: याकरणी चतुर्दशप्रक्रमान्सङ्क्षिपति त्रिंश्च प्रक्रमसप्तमभागान् स एकशतविधे प्रक्रमः
text_mt: The producing side that combines fourteen prakramas and three seventh-parts of a prakrama is the prakrama in the one-hundred-and-one-fold [altar].

sanskrit_iast: dvitīye vā saptasu prakrameṣu prakramamavadhāya tasya saptamabhāgena prakramārthaḥ
meaning: द्वितीये वा सप्तसु प्रक्रमेषु प्रक्रममवधाय तस्य सप्तमभागेन प्रक्रमार्थः
text_mt: Or, in the second [case], having placed a prakrama among seven prakramas, by its seventh part is the purpose of the prakrama [served].

sanskrit_iast: prakrameṇa vā saptamabhāgena prakramārthaḥ
meaning: प्रक्रमेण वा सप्तमभागेन प्रक्रमार्थः
text_mt: Or by a prakrama with a seventh part is the purpose of the prakrama [served].

sanskrit_iast: evamaikaśatavidhāt
meaning: एवमैकशतविधात्

sanskrit_iast: nāntaḥpātyagārhapatyayorvṛddhirbhavati tāvadeva yonirbhavati na vai jātaṃ garbhaṃ yoniranuvardhata iti śrutervṛddheratyantaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ
meaning: नान्तःपात्यगार्हपत्ययोर्वृद्धिर्भवति तावदेव योनिर्भवति न वै जातं गर्भं योनिरनुवर्धत इति श्रुतेर्वृद्धेरत्यन्तं प्रतिषेधः
text_mt: There is no increase for the antaḥpātya [peg] and the Gārhapatya; the womb is only so large, for according to the Vedic text, 'The womb surely does not grow along with the born embryo,' there is an absolute prohibition of increase.

sanskrit_iast: yāvatpramāṇāni samacaturaśrāṇyekīkartuṃ cikīrṣedekonāni tāni bhavanti tiryagdviguṇānyekata ekādhikāni tryasrirbhavati tasyeṣustatkaroti
meaning: यावत्प्रमाणानि समचतुरश्राण्येकीकर्तुं चिकीर्षेदेकोनानि तानि भवन्ति तिर्यग्द्विगुणान्येकत एकाधिकानि त्र्यस्रिर्भवति तस्येषुस्तत्करोति
text_mt: As many equal squares as one wishes to unite, they are diminished by one; doubled transversely, on one side increased by one, it becomes a triangle; its arrow produces that.

sanskrit_iast: yathāyūpaṃ vedivarddhanamityetadvakṣyāmaḥ
meaning: यथायूपं वेदिवर्द्धनमित्येतद्वक्ष्यामः
text_mt: We shall explain the enlargement of the altar ground according to the sacrificial posts.

sanskrit_iast: yā rajjurekādaśoparavānsaṅkṣipati daśa ca rathākṣāṃstasyā yaścaturviṃśo bhāgaḥ sa prakramaḥ
meaning: या रज्जुरेकादशोपरवान्सङ्क्षिपति दश च रथाक्षांस्तस्या यश्चतुर्विंशो भागः स प्रक्रमः
text_mt: The cord that combines eleven uparavas and ten chariot-axles: that which is its twenty-fourth part is a prakrama.

sanskrit_iast: tena vediṃ nirmāya dvādaśāṅgulaṃ purastādapacchidya tadyūpāvatyācchaṅkoḥ purastātprāñcamavadhāya tasmin yūpānminoti
meaning: तेन वेदिं निर्माय द्वादशाङ्गुलं पुरस्तादपच्छिद्य तद्यूपावत्याच्छङ्कोः पुरस्तात्प्राञ्चमवधाय तस्मिन् यूपान्मिनोति
text_mt: Having constructed the altar ground with that, cutting off twelve aṅgulas in front, and placing [it] facing east in front of that peg possessing the sacrificial post, he measures the sacrificial posts on it.

sanskrit_iast: pārśvayorvā'rdhamantarvedīti śruterarddhakāniti
meaning: पार्श्वयोर्वाऽर्धमन्तर्वेदीति श्रुतेरर्द्धकानिति
text_mt: Or 'half on both flanks within the altar ground,' according to the Vedic text, 'in halves.'

sanskrit_iast: eke prathamottamau prakṛtivat
meaning: एके प्रथमोत्तमौ प्रकृतिवत्
text_mt: Some say the first and the last are as in the archetype.

sanskrit_iast: saiṣā śikhaṇḍinī vediḥ
meaning: सैषा शिखण्डिनी वेदिः
text_mt: This is the crested altar ground.

sanskrit_iast: bhavanti cātra ślokāḥ-dvihaste lakṣaṇaṃ kuryāt trihasto madhyamaḥ śiraḥ
meaning: भवन्ति चात्र श्लोकाः-द्विहस्ते लक्षणं कुर्यात् त्रिहस्तो मध्यमः शिरः
text_mt: And on this there are verses: / One should make a mark at two cubits; the middle, of three cubits, is the head.

sanskrit_iast: śiraḥpaścādvitastiḥ syāt pūrvārdhe hasta eva ca sārdhahaste ca pāśaḥ syāt vediḥ syāt paurṇamāsikī
meaning: शिरःपश्चाद्वितस्तिः स्यात् पूर्वार्धे हस्त एव च सार्धहस्ते च पाशः स्यात् वेदिः स्यात् पौर्णमासिकी
text_mt: Behind the head there should be a vitasti, and in the eastern half just a cubit; / and at one cubit and a half there should be a loop; it would be the Full Moon altar ground.

sanskrit_iast: saṃkhyājñaḥ parimāṇajñaḥ samasūtranirañchakaḥ samabhūmau bhavedvidvāñchulbavit paripṛcchakaḥ
meaning: संख्याज्ञः परिमाणज्ञः समसूत्रनिरञ्छकः समभूमौ भवेद्विद्वाञ्छुल्बवित् परिपृच्छकः
text_mt: Knowing numbers, knowing measures, marking with an even cord on level ground, / the expert in the cord should be learned, an inquirer.

sanskrit_iast: na jalāt samamanyat syānnānyadvātāt pramā bhavet nānyaddūraṃ bhramādūrdhvaṃ nānyat sūtrādṛjurbhavet
meaning: न जलात् सममन्यत् स्यान्नान्यद्वातात् प्रमा भवेत् नान्यद्दूरं भ्रमादूर्ध्वं नान्यत् सूत्रादृजुर्भवेत्
text_mt: There can be nothing more level than water, there can be no measure other than wind; / there is nothing higher than turning upward, and nothing straighter than a cord.

sanskrit_iast: tiryaṅmānyāśca sarvārthaiḥ pārśvamānyāśca yogavit karaṇīnāṃ vibhāgajño nityodyuktaśca karmasu
meaning: तिर्यङ्मान्याश्च सर्वार्थैः पार्श्वमान्याश्च योगवित् करणीनां विभागज्ञो नित्योद्युक्तश्च कर्मसु
text_mt: Knowing the application of the transverse measure for all purposes and of the flank measure, / knowing the division of producing sides, and constantly devoted to the rituals,

sanskrit_iast: śāstrabudhyā vibhāgajñaḥ paraśāstrakutūhalaḥ śilpibhyaḥ sthapatibhyaśca ādadīta matīḥ sadā
meaning: शास्त्रबुध्या विभागज्ञः परशास्त्रकुतूहलः शिल्पिभ्यः स्थपतिभ्यश्च आददीत मतीः सदा
text_mt: knowing distinctions through intellect formed by the treatises, curious about other treatises, / he should always receive ideas from artisans and master builders.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaḍaṅgulaparīṇāhaṃ dvādaśāṅgulamucchritam jaraṭhe cāvraṇaṃ caiva śaṅkue kuryādviśeṣataḥ
meaning: षडङ्गुलपरीणाहं द्वादशाङ्गुलमुच्छ्रितम् जरठे चाव्रणं चैव शङ्कुए कुर्याद्विशेषतः

sanskrit_iast: dvivitastipramāṇastu khādiro mudgarastathā śaṅkustena nikhātavyastasmāttasya parigrahaḥ
meaning: द्विवितस्तिप्रमाणस्तु खादिरो मुद्गरस्तथा शङ्कुस्तेन निखातव्यस्तस्मात्तस्य परिग्रहः
text_mt: The mallet should be of khadira wood, of the measure of two vitastis; / by it the peg must be driven, therefore its acceptance.

sanskrit_iast: ekatastu ṛjustīkṣṇaḥ khādiraḥ samamāyataḥ śaṅkuḥ kāryastu śulbajñaistasyārdhaṃ gamayenmahīm
meaning: एकतस्तु ऋजुस्तीक्ष्णः खादिरः सममायतः शङ्कुः कार्यस्तु शुल्बज्ञैस्तस्यार्धं गमयेन्महीम्
text_mt: Straight on one side, sharp, of khadira wood, evenly elongated— / such a peg should be made by those who know the cord; one should drive half of it into the earth.

sanskrit_iast: prādeśamātro haviryajñe pūrvalakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ śaṅkurāmaśirāḥ kāryastasyāpyardhaṃ nikhāpayet
meaning: प्रादेशमात्रो हविर्यज्ञे पूर्वलक्षणलक्षितः शङ्कुरामशिराः कार्यस्तस्याप्यर्धं निखापयेत्
text_mt: The measure of a span in a haviryajña, marked with the aforesaid characteristic, / the peg should be made with an unshaped head; one should have half of it also driven in.

sanskrit_iast: caturasramudgaraṃ syāt ṣoḍaśāṅgulamāyatam aviddhaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ ca dārumadhyācca nirmitam
meaning: चतुरस्रमुद्गरं स्यात् षोडशाङ्गुलमायतम् अविद्धं रमणीयं च दारुमध्याच्च निर्मितम्
text_mt: The mallet should be four-cornered, sixteen aṅgulas long, / unpierced, handsome, and crafted from the heart of the wood.

sanskrit_iast: ajīrṇā'granthinī sūkṣmā samā ślakṣṇā tvaromaśā rajjurmānādhikā kāryā adhvare yogamicchatā
meaning: अजीर्णाऽग्रन्थिनी सूक्ष्मा समा श्लक्ष्णा त्वरोमशा रज्जुर्मानाधिका कार्या अध्वरे योगमिच्छता
text_mt: Not worn out, free of knots, fine, even, smooth, and hairless, / the cord should be made longer than the measure by one desiring proper application in the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: śāṇī vā bālvajī caiva vaiṇavī vā vidhīyate rajjustūbhayataḥpāśā trivṛtā yajñakarmaṇi
meaning: शाणी वा बाल्वजी चैव वैणवी वा विधीयते रज्जुस्तूभयतःपाशा त्रिवृता यज्ञकर्मणि
text_mt: Made of hemp, or indeed of bālvaja grass, or made of bamboo it is prescribed; / the cord, however, should have loops at both ends and be threefold in the sacrificial act.

sanskrit_iast: rajjurmuñjamayī kāryā śaṇaistu parimiśritā kātyāyano vadatyevamakhaṇḍā kuśabalbajaiḥ
meaning: रज्जुर्मुञ्जमयी कार्या शणैस्तु परिमिश्रिता कात्यायनो वदत्येवमखण्डा कुशबल्बजैः
text_mt: The cord should be made of muñja grass mixed with hemp; / so Kātyāyana says: undivided, with kuśa and balbaja grasses.

sanskrit_iast: navake lakṣaṇaṃ kuryāt trīṇi kuryāt triṣu triṣu uttamo navakaḥ pāśaḥ sadaso mānamucyate
meaning: नवके लक्षणं कुर्यात् त्रीणि कुर्यात् त्रिषु त्रिषु उत्तमो नवकः पाशः सदसो मानमुच्यते
text_mt: At nine one should make a mark; one should make three at every three; / the highest ninth is a loop: this is stated to be the measure of the sadas.

sanskrit_iast: pañcadaśamathaikaviṃśatikamaparaṃ parastrikaṃ ca dvādaśasu pāśa uttama iti some rajjumānametat
meaning: पञ्चदशमथैकविंशतिकमपरं परस्त्रिकं च द्वादशसु पाश उत्तम इति सोमे रज्जुमानमेतत्
text_mt: Then the fifteenth, and another, the twenty-first; further on, a triad; and at twelve the highest loop: this is the cord measure in the Soma sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: padasyākṣṇayā tiraścī tayorakṣṇayā bhavet sautrāmaṇyāṃ vimātavyā vediḥ syāt somavattayā
meaning: पदस्याक्ष्णया तिरश्ची तयोरक्ष्णया भवेत् सौत्रामण्यां विमातव्या वेदिः स्यात् सोमवत्तया
text_mt: Transverse to the diagonal cord of a pada, it would be along the diagonal cord of both; / the altar ground is to be measured in the Sautrāmaṇī like that in the Soma sacrifice with that.

sanskrit_iast: nīhāreṇa ghanairvāpi jyotiṣāmabhradarśane apsu dīpaṃ pragṛhṇīyādyāvattamasi darśane
meaning: नीहारेण घनैर्वापि ज्योतिषामभ्रदर्शने अप्सु दीपं प्रगृह्णीयाद्यावत्तमसि दर्शने
text_mt: When the luminaries cannot be seen in the sky due to mist or clouds, / one should hold a lamp over water as long as there is seeing in the darkness.

sanskrit_iast: pramāṇaṃ ca prameyaṃ ca yaccānyadvastusaṃjñakam sarvaṃ tacchāstrato jñātvā yajñe sidhyanti yājñikāḥ
meaning: प्रमाणं च प्रमेयं च यच्चान्यद्वस्तुसंज्ञकम् सर्वं तच्छास्त्रतो ज्ञात्वा यज्ञे सिध्यन्ति याज्ञिकाः
text_mt: The measure, and that which is to be measured, and whatever else is designated as an object: / having understood all that from the treatises, sacrificers succeed in the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: yathā na kṣīyate mānaṃ yathā ca na vivardhate yathā ca ramate dṛṣṭistathā yogaṃ samācaret
meaning: यथा न क्षीयते मानं यथा च न विवर्धते यथा च रमते दृष्टिस्तथा योगं समाचरेत्
text_mt: So that the measure does not decrease, and so that it does not increase unduly, / and so that the sight is pleased, so should one perform the application.

sanskrit_iast: aratniścaturasrastu pūvasyāgneḥ kharo bhavet rathacakrākṛtiḥ paścāccandrārdha iva dakṣiṇaḥ
meaning: अरत्निश्चतुरस्रस्तु पूवस्याग्नेः खरो भवेत् रथचक्राकृतिः पश्चाच्चन्द्रार्ध इव दक्षिणः
text_mt: An aratni [in length] and square should be the mound of the eastern fire; / chariot-wheel-shaped at the back; like a half-moon the southern.

sanskrit_iast: agnīnāṃ tu kharaḥ kāryo mekhalātrayasaṃyutaḥ dvādaśāṅgula ucchrāye vistāre caturaṅgulaḥ
meaning: अग्नीनां तु खरः कार्यो मेखलात्रयसंयुतः द्वादशाङ्गुल उच्छ्राये विस्तारे चतुरङ्गुलः
text_mt: The mound of the fires should be made provided with three girdles, / twelve aṅgulas in height, and four aṅgulas in breadth.

sanskrit_iast: tantuḥ puṣkaranālasya ṣaḍguṇaḥ pariveṣṭitaḥ vatsataryāstrihāyaṇyā bālena sadṛśo bhavet
meaning: तन्तुः पुष्करनालस्य षड्गुणः परिवेष्टितः वत्सतर्यास्त्रिहायण्या बालेन सदृशो भवेत्
text_mt: A fiber of a lotus stalk wound sixfold / would be equal to the hair of a three-year-old heifer.

sanskrit_iast: trayastrihāyaṇībālāḥ sarṣapārdhaṃ pracakṣate dviguṇaṃ sarṣapaṃ vidyādyavaḥ pañca tu sarṣapāḥ
meaning: त्रयस्त्रिहायणीबालाः सर्षपार्धं प्रचक्षते द्विगुणं सर्षपं विद्याद्यवः पञ्च तु सर्षपाः
text_mt: Three hairs of a three-year-old heifer are declared to be half a mustard seed; / one should know a mustard seed as double [that]; a barleycorn is five mustard seeds.

sanskrit_iast: aṅgulasya pramāṇaṃ tu ṣaḍyavāḥ pārśvasaṃsthitāḥ caturviṃśāṅgulo'ratnirvitastirdvādaśāṅgulā
meaning: अङ्गुलस्य प्रमाणं तु षड्यवाः पार्श्वसंस्थिताः चतुर्विंशाङ्गुलोऽरत्निर्वितस्तिर्द्वादशाङ्गुला
text_mt: The measure of an aṅgula is six barleycorns placed side by side; / an aratni is twenty-four aṅgulas; a vitasti is twelve aṅgulas.

sanskrit_iast: vyāmasyātra pramāṇaṃ tu caturnyūnaṃ śataṃ bhavet puruṣasya pramāṇaṃ vai viṃśatistu śatādhikā
meaning: व्यामस्यात्र प्रमाणं तु चतुर्न्यूनं शतं भवेत् पुरुषस्य प्रमाणं वै विंशतिस्तु शताधिका
text_mt: The measure of a vyāma here would be one hundred diminished by four; / the measure of a puruṣa indeed is twenty added to one hundred.

sanskrit_iast: hiraṇyaśakalārthe tu hiraṇyaṃ yasya nocyate kṛṣṇalenaiva tadvyākhyā yajñe sidhyati yājñikī
meaning: हिरण्यशकलार्थे तु हिरण्यं यस्य नोच्यते कृष्णलेनैव तद्व्याख्या यज्ञे सिध्यति याज्ञिकी
text_mt: For the purpose of a gold chip, where gold is not specified, / its sacrificial explanation succeeds in the sacrifice only by means of a kṛṣṇala.

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇalaṃ triyavaṃ mānaṃ tāmrāyasamataḥ param suvarṇādardhaṃ ca māṣāṇāṃ suvarṇāśca trisaptatiḥ
meaning: कृष्णलं त्रियवं मानं ताम्रायसमतः परम् सुवर्णादर्धं च माषाणां सुवर्णाश्च त्रिसप्ततिः
text_mt: A kṛṣṇala is a measure of three barleycorns; beyond this is copper and iron; / and half of a suvarṇa of māṣas; and seventy-three suvarṇas,

sanskrit_iast: trīṇi caiva sahasrāṇi dadyādbahusuvarṇake bhūyaḥ sthapatito jñātvā saṃjñāsvanyāsu mānavit svarṇakāro yathā'bhyāsāttathā bhūyo vivardhate
meaning: त्रीणि चैव सहस्राणि दद्याद्बहुसुवर्णके भूयः स्थपतितो ज्ञात्वा संज्ञास्वन्यासु मानवित् स्वर्णकारो यथाऽभ्यासात्तथा भूयो विवर्धते
text_mt: and three thousand one should give in a bahusuvarṇaka [sacrifice]; / knowing further from a master builder about other designations, the knower of measures, / just as a goldsmith through practice, so further increases [in skill].

sanskrit_iast: hrasate śoṣapākābhyāṃ dvātriṃśadbhāgamiṣṭakā tasmādārdrapramāṇaṃ tu kuryānmānādhikaṃ budhaḥ
meaning: ह्रसते शोषपाकाभ्यां द्वात्रिंशद्भागमिष्टका तस्मादार्द्रप्रमाणं तु कुर्यान्मानाधिकं बुधः
text_mt: A brick shrinks by drying and baking by a thirty-second part; / therefore, the wise one should make the wet measure larger than the [intended] measure.

sanskrit_iast: ajñātvā śulbasadbhāvaṃ yajñe sautrāmaṇīsute vediṃ ye kartumicchanti giriṃ bhindanti te nakhaiḥ
meaning: अज्ञात्वा शुल्बसद्भावं यज्ञे सौत्रामणीसुते वेदिं ये कर्तुमिच्छन्ति गिरिं भिन्दन्ति ते नखैः
text_mt: Without knowing the true nature of the cord in the sacrifice and in the Sautrāmaṇī pressing, / those who wish to make the altar ground split a mountain with their fingernails.

sanskrit_iast: daṇḍarajjvardhamabhyasya ṣaṣṭhe tvardhasya lakṣaṇam tathaiva cetaratrāpi tiryaṅmānaṃ yadṛcchayā
meaning: दण्डरज्ज्वर्धमभ्यस्य षष्ठे त्वर्धस्य लक्षणम् तथैव चेतरत्रापि तिर्यङ्मानं यदृच्छया
text_mt: Having multiplied half of the rod-cord, at the sixth, however, is the mark of the half; / just so elsewhere also, the transverse measure is at will.

sanskrit_iast: yāvatpramāṇā rajjuḥ syāttāvānevāgamo bhavet āgamārdhe bhavecchaṅkustadardhe ca nirañchanam
meaning: यावत्प्रमाणा रज्जुः स्यात्तावानेवागमो भवेत् आगमार्धे भवेच्छङ्कुस्तदर्धे च निरञ्छनम्
text_mt: As much as the measure of the cord may be, so much indeed should be the addition; / at half the addition should be the peg, and at half of that the intermediate marker.

sanskrit_iast: ādhāne padikaṃ kuryāt dvipadaḥ saumiko bhavet agnau ca tripadaṃ kuryāt prakramaṃ yājñiko budhaḥ
meaning: आधाने पदिकं कुर्यात् द्विपदः सौमिको भवेत् अग्नौ च त्रिपदं कुर्यात् प्रक्रमं याज्ञिको बुधः
text_mt: At the installation of the fires, the wise sacrificer should make [the prakrama] one pada; in the soma sacrifice it should be two padas; / and at the fire altar he should make the prakrama three padas.

sanskrit_iast: kṛttikā śravaṇaḥ puṣyaścitrāsvātyoryadantaram etatprācyā diśo rūpaṃ yugamātrodite puraḥ
meaning: कृत्तिका श्रवणः पुष्यश्चित्रास्वात्योर्यदन्तरम् एतत्प्राच्या दिशो रूपं युगमात्रोदिते पुरः
text_mt: The Pleiades (Kṛttikās), Śravaṇā, Puṣya, and the interval between Citrā and Svātī— / this is the form of the eastern direction in front, when [the star] has risen by a yoke-measure.

sanskrit_iast: pañcāśaccharkarāḥ paścāt pūrve deyāstrisaptatiḥ dakṣiṇe tu pradātavyā daśa pañca ca sapta ca
meaning: पञ्चाशच्छर्कराः पश्चात् पूर्वे देयास्त्रिसप्ततिः दक्षिणे तु प्रदातव्या दश पञ्च च सप्त च
text_mt: Fifty pebbles are to be placed in the west, seventy-three in the east, / but in the south are to be placed ten, five, and seven.

sanskrit_iast: śaṃsyaścaturviṃśatipārśvabhāgaścaturdaśabhiḥ parilekhyastu naryam tathaiva cāṣṭadviguṇairatharyyastriṃśadbhirāyamya harettṛtīyam
meaning: शंस्यश्चतुर्विंशतिपार्श्वभागश्चतुर्दशभिः परिलेख्यस्तु नर्यम् तथैव चाष्टद्विगुणैरथर्य्यस्त्रिंशद्भिरायम्य हरेत्तृतीयम्
text_mt: The flank portion is to be recited as twenty-four; with fourteen, however, the narya is to be marked out; / and likewise with sixteen, and drawing out with thirty, one should take the third.

sanskrit_iast: agnerudaksārdhanavāṅgule madhyaṃ tato likhet vṛttamekonaviṃśatyā prācījyā madhyagā bhavet udagardhaṃ vihāyārvāk kharāgnerdakṣiṇasya tu
meaning: अग्नेरुदक्सार्धनवाङ्गुले मध्यं ततो लिखेत् वृत्तमेकोनविंशत्या प्राचीज्या मध्यगा भवेत् उदगर्धं विहायार्वाक् खराग्नेर्दक्षिणस्य तु
text_mt: Nine and a half aṅgulas north of the fire [altar] is the centre; from there one should draw / a circle with nineteen [aṅgulas radius]; the east-west chord should pass through the centre; / leaving aside the northern half, [the remaining part] on the hither side belongs to the southern fire-mound.

sanskrit_iast: sūtradoṣadaridrasya gūḍhamantrasya dhīmataḥ samāpteyaṃ kriyā śaulbī kātyāyanamahātmanaḥ
meaning: सूत्रदोषदरिद्रस्य गूढमन्त्रस्य धीमतः समाप्तेयं क्रिया शौल्बी कात्यायनमहात्मनः
text_mt: Free from defects of the sūtra, of profound mantras, of the wise, / great-souled Kātyāyana, this rite of the cord is completed.
